title: Lijing Domain Event Envelope
description: Stable metadata envelope for versioned, traceable, idempotent domain events.

event_id.description: Globally unique event identity used for consumer de-duplication.

event_type.description: Stable event name, for example MasteryUpdated or RewardGranted.

event_version.description: Semantic version of this event type's payload contract.

actor_id.description: Authenticated actor or null for a system-originated event.

schema_version.description: Version of the envelope schema, independent from the event payload version.

payload.description: Event-specific data owned by the publishing module.
